notes: Requirements are taken from the programme's Parcoursup sheet: the French B2 level and the subject prerequisites. NOTE: that sheet describes admission via Parcoursup, which the task says applies to French and European Bac holders, while a Moroccan Baccalauréat holder applies through Études en France / Campus France; these conditions should therefore be confirmed for the international route. Tuition: the programme's own sheet states 178 euros per year, which is the national non-scholarship licence rate, not the differentiated (2,902 euros) rate that the Campus France Morocco page says non-EU students must pay for a Licence year; an auditor must check which rate applies to this applicant.

evidence.quote: Niveau de français requis pour s'inscrire à la formation : B2

note.fr: Les candidatures sont examinées par une commission : les résultats scolaires comptent pour 90 %, les méthodes de travail pour 5 % et le savoir-être pour 5 %. Aucun seuil de notes n'est publié.
note.en: Applications are reviewed by a commission: academic results count for 90%, working methods for 5% and soft skills for 5%. No grade threshold is published.

evidence.quote: Résultats scolaires 90 % Méthodes de travail 5 % Savoir-être 5 %
